maddeler.e:
نتماوت (form VI)
# نَتَمَاوَتُ (natamāwatu) /na.ta.maː.wa.tu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
# نَتَمَاوَتَ (natamāwata) /na.ta.maː.wa.ta/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
# نَتَمَاوَتْ (natamāwat) /na.ta.maː.wat/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَاوَتَ (tamāwata)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
